summary.tldr: Raises the volunteer firefighter and search and rescue volunteer tax credits from $3,000 to $10,000 and changes the definition of eligible volunteer firefighting services.
what_it_does: Raises the volunteer firefighter tax credit under the Income Tax Act from $3,000 to $10,000 for an eligible year.
Raises the search and rescue volunteer tax credit from $3,000 to $10,000 for an eligible year.
Changes the definition of eligible volunteer firefighting services to include being available or on call for firefighting, emergency, and non-emergency duties.
Allows a volunteer firefighter to receive nominal pay that does not count as a liveable wage.
summary.background: The bill says the new rules apply to the 2022 and later taxation years.
